system.name: Fictional Payments — illustrative architecture
exclusions: No real infrastructure is queried; all evidence is fictional.

nodes.label: Employee deploy account
nodes.details: Can deploy API code; cannot replace independent settlement code.

nodes.label: Customer
nodes.details: Controls customer signing credential and its recovery.

nodes.label: Independent approver
nodes.details: Can replace settlement code; outside API and employee access.

nodes.label: API runtime control
nodes.details: Fictional production API. Employee can deploy code. Environment exposes OPERATIONS_SIGNER and DESTINATION_ADMIN references, not customer key.

nodes.label: Use operations signer
nodes.details: Available to API; company administers/replaces it. No independent payout approval authority.

nodes.label: Use destination admin
nodes.details: Available to API. Can change destination policy; this deliberately demonstrates a defeated boundary.

nodes.label: Use customer signing key
nodes.details: Held by customer; replacement requires customer authority. Not available to API or employee.

nodes.label: Control settlement enforcement
nodes.details: Independent deployment. Replacing settlement code permits payout bypass; represented explicitly.

nodes.label: Control refund policy
nodes.details: External provider ownership and recipient/recovery rules are unresolved.

nodes.label: Approve external payout
nodes.details: Requires customer-bound signature or control of settlement enforcement.

nodes.label: Redirect provider refund
nodes.details: Provider route exists; effective destination permissions are unknown.
